fields.Name: T154 - Browse Segments
fields.Description: Verifies the Segments entity opens via the Data Explorer sidebar search and displays a grid of segment records.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Segments' entity via the left sidebar 'Search entities...' box: click the search box, type 'Segments', then click the exact 'Segments' node in the results. Do NOT expand the entity group/chevron - use the search box. Verify a grid of records is displayed (multiple rows, or a valid empty-state for sparse entities). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait patiently, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The 'Segments' entity is selected in the Data Explorer Data section
A row grid of segment records is displayed (multiple rows, or a valid empty-state)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
